sermons.title: Who You Are in Christ
summary: Your identity is not what you feel or what people say — it's what God says.
Every believer is a new creation with a new nature and new authority.
Right believing about identity produces right living.

sermons.title: Living With Purpose in Your Generation
summary: Every generation has an assignment God intends to fulfil through willing believers.
Serving your generation begins with discovering your specific grace.
Consistency and character make purpose sustainable.
